title: This six-course Claude AI and ChatGPT training bundle is $29.99
excerpt: Everything you need to actually use AI at work, minus the guesswork.
content_html:
TL;DR: This 2026 Complete Claude AI, Claude Code, Claude Cowork and ChatGPT Training Bundle is $29.99 (reg. $174), giving you lifetime access to six courses and 16 hours of instruction on using today’s leading AI tools for work.

Credit: Paul Ashun

$29.99
$174 Save $144.01

Most people using AI are still only scratching the surface of what it can do. This bundle is built to close that gap.

For $29.99, you get lifetime access to six courses and 16 hours of AI training covering ChatGPT 5, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork, a markdown from the $174 list price.

The lineup starts with a ChatGPT 5 masterclass covering prompt engineering, content creation, and workflow automation, then moves into two Claude Cowork courses that teach you how to connect Claude to Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, and dozens of other apps to automate tasks without writing code.

A Claude Code course walks Agile and PM professionals through using AI for project workflows, and a Claude AI masterclass rounds out the no-code side of things. An AI LLM fundamentals course and a bonus AI product manager skills course are also included for anyone who wants the underlying concepts, not just the tools.

Every course was built by Paul Ashun, a consultant who has led software projects for companies including the BBC, General Electric, and Oracle. Access is available on desktop and mobile, and each course comes with a certificate of completion once finished. Your code has to be redeemed within 30 days of purchase, so it is worth activating it soon after buying even if you plan to work through the material over time.

This bundle fits business professionals, project managers, marketers, and freelancers who want to fold AI into daily work instead of treating it as a side experiment. It also works for anyone starting from scratch, since the courses are built for all experience levels.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get lifetime access to all six courses in The 2026 Complete Claude AI, Claude Code, Claude Cowork and ChatGPT Training Bundle for $29.99 (reg. $174).

StackSocial prices subject to change.
